左右两组之间有一条竖线，从左边框到这条线是一段，从这条线到右边框是另一段，两段长度比约为 1 比 0.618。

The left and right spans run about 1 to 0.618.

units.nameEn: Letters as a window: one pattern runs through the word
units.descriptionZh:
图案只在整词上铺一次，由字的轮廓裁切出来。
各字里的条纹、星点相位必须彼此对得上；一旦对不上，一眼就看出是逐字各贴了一份。
units.descriptionEn:
The pattern is laid down once across the whole word and the letterforms crop it.
The stripes and stars have to hold one phase from letter to letter. The moment they do not line up, the fill reads as decoration pasted into each letter.

units.nameEn: Inline: one hairline runs inside the stroke

粗笔画沿中心轴留一条背景色的细线，字立刻透气。
笔画照常填色，只沿中心轴留一条背景色的细线，两端各留一小段不切通。字越粗，这条线救回的呼吸越多。
units.descriptionEn:
A heavy stroke keeps one line of the ground showing along its centre, and the letter breathes again.
Fill the stroke as usual but leave one line of background along its centre axis, stopping short of both ends. The heavier the face, the more that line gives back.

大标题只描边不填色，描边粗细取画面线图的线宽。
字号一大，实心字就把插画压死；改成空心，并把描边粗细调成与线稿完全同一个值，字与图才落在同一层上。

A huge title is drawn as an outline only, at the same weight as the lines of the drawing.

units.nameEn: Arc baseline: every glyph turns to the tangent
units.descriptionZh:
整行字沿一条圆弧走，每个字按所在位置的切线角自转。
先定圆弧，再把每个字绕自己的基线点转到该处的切线角；弯道外侧会拉开，必须补一点负字距，否则词在弧上散架。
units.descriptionEn:
The line rides an arc and each glyph rotates to the tangent at its own position.
Fix the arc first, then rotate each glyph about its own baseline point to the tangent there. The outside of the curve opens up, so pull some of that gap back or the word falls apart along the arc.
